title: The Wandering Merchant
openingText: Aldric spreads his hands across a table covered in goods and ledgers. 'You've caught me at a good time,' he says. 'I've wares and I've needs, and I suspect we might find some common ground. Let's talk terms.'
dialogueWalkaway: This isn't worth my time. Good day.
dialogueAccept: Pleasure doing business. Come find me again when you need something.
confidence: The discount is real. The prices it comes off were raised for you this morning.

clauses.text: Aldric will pay 50 gold for safe passage intel about the region.
Aldric's factors sell to your guild at a tenth off, and the caravan houses hear of it.
A 'processing fee' of 15 gold, buried in the small print.
Aldric buys 15 of your supplies at caravan rates: 45 gold on delivery.
Their trade charts: every road and ford their factors use
Your column rides escort for their next shipment
Exclusive dealing with them this cycle
